item.title: White House criticizes Rosie O'Donnell after Kimmel appearance
item.description: The White House responded to Rosie O'Donnell, calling her a 'nasty woman' and claiming her mind has been 'destroyed' by Trump Derangement Syndrome.

item.title: Don't Fear Flock Cameras
item.description: Rolling back Flock won't reverse this long-term change, but it will deprive law enforcement of a valuable tool.

item.title: Rep. Harriet Hageman: How Trump Can Close Birth Tourism Loopholes
item.description: Rep. Hageman says President Trump has the authority to close the nation's birth tourism loopholes.

item.title: Trump Admin Moves to End ABA's Monopoly on Law School Accreditation
item.description: The Trump administration announced Friday it is proceeding with efforts to break the American Bar Association's control over law school accreditation.
